system.description:
This incantation binds mud into an animated being, creating a temporary servant that you can command. The thrall is roughly humanoid in shape and may dissolve into a creeping pool of mud and reform itself as commanded.

It can comprehend simple instructions and will obey any order from its master, even one that would result in its own destruction, though it may show reluctance. A mud thrall may only communicate by nodding or shaking its featureless head.

Mud thralls never tire and excel at manual labor. A thrall of human size can carry a load of 50 lbs., whereas smaller specimens can carry proportionally less. Timid and unable to fight, a mud thrall fearfully collapses into normal mud as soon as it encounters a creature hostile to it or its master.

A mud thrall disintegrates after 1 hour. Each spark affects its size: the thrall is diminutive with zero sparks, tiny with one, small with two, medium with three, large with four, or huge with five or more.
